Preserve lowercase digits, negative signs, exact signed widths and unsigned64 bits, original null-before-radix checked guards, terminating zero and all untouched initialized buffer sentinels. The native caller uses96-unit sufficient buffers, all signed16 decimal inputs, all35 valid radices, signed32/signed64/unsigned64 power boundaries and deterministic wide inputs, with full unchanged346-source dependencies under normal and ASan/UBSan. Nine checked native fatal assertions remain separate diagnostics and map to Error; no defined post-abort result is claimed. Preserve original33/65/65 capacity macros despite CALC044: negative minima in base2 need34/66 units including zero. Macro-sized buffers, StringNumber/OUString::number/concat, original NDEBUG invalid-radix fallback, malformed JS arguments/storage, physical ABI and full consumer/upstream QA remain unverified. This closes a required original interface-factory derived-name formatting dependency, not the full interface/default-exception/case-service/document/UI path. No extra formatting library, lossy64-bit Number conversion or source-method replacement.
